description: The Master's consented data-lake intake for uplift, traces and artifacts. It extends uplift-schema.json; the lake is training and backup evidence, never an answer corpus and never a peer knowledge channel.

record.consent: Must be true; a missing or false consent is refused before storage.
record.digest: 64 lowercase hex characters over the stored bytes.
record.retention_days: 1..3650; the intake refuses a longer retention without an explicit signed exception.
record.signature_b64: The peer node's signature over the record projection; it proves provenance, not authority.

storage.root: The Master's uplift state directory, outside every vault and outside the 4223 corpus.
storage.index: A signed manifest of records, digests and retention; no payload is inlined in the index.
storage.never_served: The lake is never served by 4223, never installed into a vault, never used as an answer corpus and never enters a peer AI context.

rules: Consent is per record and per user; opted-out data is never stored.
A record is training or backup evidence, never authority.
Redaction happens before storage; a secret that reaches the lake is a leak, not training data.
Retention is enforced by the intake; deletion is recorded, not silent.
A peer cannot read the lake; only the Master's distillation and backup jobs may consume it.
